method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the client of a law practice, with the associated third party payer where the Act gives that person the client's rights), with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING where it does not answer); the dates in one module (the only one importing daydate), the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; two regulative rules (s 316(2) MUST on the law practice; ss 313(1), 316(4), (5) SHANT on the law practice) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Legal Profession Act 2007 (Tas), No. 24 of 2007, the consolidated version published 2026-05-05 and current on the Tasmanian Legislation website on 6 November 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2007-024.txt. The Legal Profession Regulations and the Statutory Holidays Act 2000 are not deposited: their numbers are asked as facts. Penalties in penalty units (not converted).
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is Tasmanian legislation, copyright State of Tasmania, under CC BY 4.0, attributed as the Tasmanian Legislation website requires; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the client of a law practice (the person for whom legal services are provided, for example on a no-win no-fee agreement for a claim), and the associated third party payer where the Act gives that person the client's rights: who is a third party payer or sophisticated client, whether Part 3.3 applies, costs disclosure and the effect of failing to give it, the basis of recovery and interest, conditional costs agreements, cooling-off, uplift fees, contingency fees, void agreements and repayment, setting aside, itemised bills, when the client can be sued, and costs assessment with its time limits (lpatas-costs.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lpatas-dates.l4 ; l4 run lpatas-costs.l4 ; l4 run lpatas-cases.l4
checks.result: 187 assertions written, 187 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); two deliberately wrong assertions in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

also_reads: Legal Profession Regulations (Tas) (not deposited: disclosure threshold, maximum interest rate, excluded matters)
Statutory Holidays Act 2000 (Tas) (not deposited: business days)
